- Fraud_card_not_present window: 120 days.
- Duplicate_charge window: 60 days.
- Service_not_rendered window: 90 days.
- Unauthorized_debit window: 56 days.
- Disputes filed after the window are not eligible.
- Filing under the wrong reason code will be declined and may require refile (risking passing the window).
- Withdrawing a dispute is final; same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
